permiso.aviso_texto: The JARANA team uses your location only while the page is open, to build your route and know when you arrive at each place. We do not ask for your name, email or phone: your progress is saved with an anonymous session on this phone. We do not sell or share your data. You can refuse or withdraw permission at any time from your browser, or use explorer mode (Mexican Federal Personal Data Protection Law, LFPDPPP).
permiso.terminos_texto: JARANA is a free tourism game: doubloons have no monetary value and promotions depend on each business.
